observed_benefit: Noema supplies domain proposal, authorization and action-success records with observed causal predecessors without application-written lifecycle logging.
limits: The examples use deterministic rules, synthetic inputs and local tools with zero model calls.
Noema is longer in physical adapter source lines; general simplicity is not established.
Persistence checks span separate processes at completed observation boundaries, not crashes during effects.
Durable timer rearming, cross-worker races, external exactly-once effects and production always-on reliability are not established.
